column1: # golden-db-red-dump.tsv: red pieces of every golden-sample reference, read back from the built
# kjv.sqlite through open_verified (sqlite3_deserialize of the hashed bytes). Machine-extracted:
# the words are cut from the stored verse text by the stored code-point offsets, never typed.
# generator: pipeline/examples/golden_red_dump.rs. One line per piece; a verse without red has one
# line with '-'. first_words/last_words: the first/last 4 space-separated words of the piece.
